scope: All three fold-local source populations; one shared legal initialization and both fixed V24 endpoints per fold; clean fused-feature prototype and sample geometry only
launch_prerequisites: original Q1 terminal with three paired folds and exit0
all input checkpoint, memory, config and source SHA bindings match
feature: 7680D deployed fused embedding; existing deterministic evaluation transform, FP32, no autocast
measurements: Per-source-record global and environment CE, target probability, prediction, candidate count and global positive/nearest-negative prototype cosine; all94 identity means
Per-source-record nearest negative, nearest/hardest nonself positive, true cross-camera-positive subset and source-only cosine margins
Difference between nearest sample negative cosine and nearest fresh identity-prototype negative cosine
All108 cached/fresh identity-camera and all94 global prototype cosine agreements; original update counts/steps
Raw feature tensor hash, full model state unchanged hash, initial memory exact reconstruction, original loss mean identity check
boundaries: Seen-source descriptive diagnosis, not independent unknown-identity validation or a new retrieval result
Clean-image CE does not replay the distribution of strong training augmentations
Fresh prototypes include the same source records being scored; their accuracy is in-sample
Cached final prototypes originate from weak augmented training features; cached/fresh disagreement mixes view distribution and model drift
Prototype/sample margin differences are descriptive association and do not prove a causal explanation for held-out Q1 changes
No weight, temperature, momentum, sampler, augmentation, epoch, architecture or promotion-rule changes
All tensors/images/model runtime remains remote; local checks limited to source, JSON and numeric metadata
output: Unique remote artifact directory containing diagnostic.json and immutable launch/log/exit receipts; no feature tensor export to the local machine
